parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: The emotion expressed by the two animated blue eyes; no emoji or text glyphs.
parameters.constraints: Exactly one of: clear, smile, happy, laugh, thinking, surprised, sad, love, angry, scared, playful. clear smoothly returns the eyes to neutral.

Display.doc: Smoothly change the procedural eye expression. clear returns to neutral. Never render an emoji as the expression. Does not modify captions or speech. The Assistant clears its previous expression on new user speech.

Robot.doc: Perform a complete base sway with fixed preparation, base yaw -30/+30/center degrees, and fixed ending. On iPhone these use fixed Cartesian poses: home [200,0,200]mm, ready [200,0,240]mm, body and home ending, with pitch0 and claw0 degrees. The controller handles joint calibration and interpolates each body transition over800ms. They are independent of the starting posture. Only perform on user request with a connected arm and clear motion area; keep app foreground. A new explicit request is independent of prior unconfirmed motion; it starts with a fixed3000ms approach without requiring old feedback. No automatic retry. Intermediate poses require observed arrival; final home requires three stable telemetry samples. Reset can interrupt. Do not claim completion from markup or transmission. Use wait for actions that must follow completion.

parameters.name: cycles
parameters.description: Number of complete gestures, each containing two back-and-forth sweeps.

Robot.doc: Nod yes with motor 4 only during the body. Establish fixed Cartesian home first, sweep the calibrated home joint by +/-33 degrees twice at speed1400 encoder counts/s with firmware acceleration, center and return to observed home. Use for an explicit request to nod or shake the head, not base rotation. Requires a connected arm, clear space and foreground. Await fresh encoder arrival for each body frame and stable physical home at the end; feedback silence and completion watchdogs can fail the Action. Settings tests send without waiting for feedback. No automatic retry; reset can interrupt.
